definitions.gloss: traditional Japanese umbrella; Japanese paper umbrella
definitions.explanation: A traditional umbrella made with a bamboo frame and Japanese paper (washi), coated with oil for waterproofing. Distinguished from Western-style umbrellas (洋傘).

notes:
USAGE:
{和傘|わがさ} contrasts with {洋傘|ようがさ} (Western umbrella). In modern Japan, {和傘|わがさ} are primarily decorative or used in traditional arts, tea ceremonies, and festivals rather than as everyday rain gear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和傘|わがさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧ (to hold up a Japanese umbrella)

- ⟦{番傘|ばんがさ}→番傘：06295_bangasa⟧ (a common type of plain Japanese umbrella)
- ⟦{蛇|じゃ}の{目|め}{傘|がさ}→蛇の目傘：06452_janomegasa⟧ (bull's-eye pattern umbrella)
